body:
Final coordinator review of two published source-review shards found that several no-change outcomes defer already-authorized curation rather than identify a missing scientific fact. Worker04 head `0d2c73e5aee5adb88782537755472d9ca0c5c3cd`; worker08 head `7efd3f8b98f9e822431dcb510c2c242a2569cfc7`; both depend on #1158 at `e000d66`.

Concrete examples:

- Worker08 case `CM_NAME:b9a945a3356d0c885eea986a2f6223e78c8e7d7163ee95629061a640294cbbe8` (H2O deionized) correctly distinguishes deionization from distillation, but its remaining requirement is to perform native owner lookup and use or create the appropriately scoped owner. [DSMZ533](https://www.dsmz.de/microorganisms/medium/pdf/DSMZ_Medium533.pdf) explicitly identifies deionized water in both main and trace stock. No proposal or completed lookup disposition accompanies that deferred step.
- Worker08 case `CM_NAME:e69128522cfe555f63dd51d4a23ece86363290b3839180386b090f368b28d1cc` (glycine-NaOH buffer) preserves a source-defined concentration and pH, and correctly finds a receiving-medium volume transcription error. [JCM906](https://www.jcm.riken.jp/cgi-bin/jcm/jcm_grmd?GRMD=906) specifies the separately prepared buffer. The decision defers representing the stock without explaining which missing fact prevents a bounded preparation identity. It must not be equated to pure glycine or assigned invented titrant amounts.
- Worker04 case `CM_NAME:2f91fab8feab468a33e48d01e2f0a1363b9ad70816766c69a1e8d68c0ed6f8d5` describes the [NBRC15](https://www.nite.go.jp/nbrc/catalogue/NBRCMediumDetailServlet?NO=15) treated, clarified V-8 preparation but defers representing it until later curation. Lack of a molecular mapping or extraction yield does not by itself establish that a source-qualified preparation cannot be represented with an honest partial assertion.

Related outcomes defer normality-qualified NaOH stocks, source-specific top layers, C9322 supplied-form review, and malted wheat meal because an exact molecular/ontology mapping or later complete-owner review is absent. These are leads for reassessment, not predetermined identity approvals. Genuine solvent, formulation, provenance or supplied-form uncertainties may remain after primary research.

Reassess the full no-change cohorts against MAPPING_SEMANTICS sections3/6 and add-media. Complete supported proposal work, or state the precise scientific fact still missing and the actual primary-source searches. Keep receiving-medium dose/unit repair separate from ingredient identity. Never invent concentrations, solvent, chemistry, product equivalence, component completeness, or exact ontology matches; preserve all native holds and old review bytes. Require separate skeptical review of successor evidence/payloads and ordinary commits/pushes on the existing worker branches. No maintained data or export approval is requested from workers.

This extends the same class of completeness problem seen in #1163 and #1193 to distinct final shards; those earlier findings remain preserved. Exact frozen decisions and capture hashes are retained in the coordinator's immutable `w04-w08-deferred-curation-v1/review-inputs.json` and will accompany the campaign evidence. This is a review-completeness finding, not a statement that every listed source must map.

comments.body:
The same confirmed completeness defect also occurs in published worker02 head `58f885fef05f8ff6e8b9b56fcb2479fef23b55c8`, so it is tracked here rather than as a duplicate issue.

Case `CM_NAME:0e073b816603e0f1cb41a47e4e5ff944bc69eaad591ece800dce675d335e4341` (Meat filtrate) already binds the original DSMZ110a preparation and explicitly states that the remaining task is to curate that source-defined formulation. It has no proposal. The captured [primary recipe](https://www.dsmz.de/microorganisms/medium/pdf/DSMZ_Medium110a.pdf) is SHA256 `4d34e2a937cbfc9520977bca08d23d4a281a82701a8de1d2bdade4946cbb7797`. Source alternatives and treatment must be retained; the coordinator has not selected a meat species or asserted extract equivalence.

Likewise, JCM1182 dilute sulfuric-acid stock, the JCM378 source-local Sol.1 base, JCM149 standard mineral base and manufacturer-defined Whatman grade1 paper have no-change requirements that defer representation or lookup without identifying a distinct blocking scientific fact. These need bounded proposal/duplicate-owner assessment or a precise missing-fact conclusion, not automatic mapping. Several concentration-labelled cases also mix receiving-medium unit repair with stock identity.

Worker02 will reassess its no-change cohort, preserve its original published review and payload bytes, and obtain separate review of any successor. This adds no authority to edit maintained data, invent solvent or quantity, choose unresolved product/form alternatives, activate generic source-local aliases, or clear native holds. The exact case/evidence snapshot is preserved in `w02-deferred-curation-v1/review-inputs.json`.

Independent coordinator review confirms another instance of this same completeness issue; recording it here avoids a duplicate.

Worker10 published head `dbaf4629f3b93d3bd8a78028e243abfe90c7a922` marks all188 cases scientifically complete, but three confirmed treated-serum outcomes defer authorized bounded curation without identifying a missing identity fact:

- Case6 (`CM_NAME:09f2616c0419d3c5e41510de6e72d5049bc9e6d4972f1585f4eeeef22f3aa82f`): [MediaDive1895](https://mediadive.dsmz.de/rest/medium/1895) explicitly identifies human serum heated56C for30minutes. The no-change reason asks for supplier/donor pooling for a *more specific* product, without assessing a source-qualified preparation at the demonstrated scope.
- Case25 (`CM_NAME:316417d34678ed79ad9434e3e19f8b26ae08331f64fcd37f7e8d94fb3db5a212`): [JCM144](https://www.jcm.riken.jp/cgi-bin/jcm/jcm_grmd?GRMD=144) and TOGOM135 specify rabbit serum56C for1hour. Its missing requirement concerns upstream receiving-medium units, not an unresolved preparation identity.
- Case40 (`CM_NAME:476112c47845e5420e3f8087392a3bfa6b9a925db47ed21f7ed933eb1d699c2f`): [JCM946](https://www.jcm.riken.jp/cgi-bin/jcm/jcm_grmd?GRMD=946) specifies rabbit serum56C for30minutes and prior filtration. It similarly defers for receiving-medium unit repair. These two preparations must remain distinct.

All three have no proposal and no completed owner lookup recorded in `owner_records`. Their primary captures were verified from committed Git objects against the evidence hashes. The existing skeptical review accepts the holds, so this requires an actual successor review rather than relabelling completion metadata.

Reassess the full no-proposal cohort under MAPPING_SEMANTICS sections3/6 and add-media. Complete native owner lookup and supported source-qualified preparation/supplied-form proposals, or state the specific missing scientific fact and primary-source search that prevents them. Separate ingredient identity from receiving-medium dose repair. Do not invent supplier equivalence, concentrations, molecular components, global aliases or release approval; do not merge human/rabbit or30/60minute preparations. Preserve prior assessments and independently review new payloads.

This is the same completeness class as #1193, applied to a distinct published worker10 cohort. It does not assert that every held case must map. Exact decisions, primary captures, hashes and reviewer scope are retained in `preflight/w10-published-head-review-v1/finding-001-treated-serum-completeness.json`.

Finding SHA256 `4bf773d69f88c0e31142e204186984863d4f8ed9570edea5ee65d65058a0892c`. No maintained data changed.

title: Complete deferred source-qualified curation in final unmatched review shards
